content: My son completed his Hifz at Minhaajulhudaa. The teachers are dedicated and the environment is perfect for Islamic learning.
My daughter can now read and understand Arabic texts independently. The Arabic immersion program is excellent.
The graduates of Minhaajulhudaa are well-prepared for advanced Islamic studies. The curriculum is thorough and authentic.
The Tahdheeb (Islamic etiquette) program has transformed my children's behavior at home. May Allah reward the teachers.
